title: Transfer: clean a names log

blocks.md:
## Scrub a messy file

`messy.txt` has blank lines, spaces, and duplicate names. `clean(text)` returns unique trimmed names, sorted, one per line.

Print the cleaned text (ending with `west` on the last line).

blocks.promptMd: > Clean `messy.txt` and print unique sorted names.

hintLadder.md: trim, filter Boolean, unique with Set, sort, join newlines.
